Case study · 2026

Modern E-Commerce Storefront

A responsive storefront with product browsing, categories, promotional sections and cart interactions.

Live project · GitHub repository

Role
Frontend development and interface design
Platforms
Web
Year
2026

Problem

A product catalogue needs to make browsing, category discovery and shopping actions feel simple across screen sizes.

Process

  1. Structure

    Organized navigation, category sections, a promotional hero and product cards into a clear browsing flow.

  2. Interaction

    Added shopping actions and data-driven product presentation so the interface feels like a usable storefront rather than a static mockup.

  3. Build

    Implemented the responsive frontend with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and JSON data.

Result

A live responsive storefront demonstrates the core browsing and shopping interaction patterns in a lightweight frontend.

Stack

  • HTML
  • CSS
  • JavaScript
  • JSON
  • Responsive Design
